assessment: This paper provides important advances in utilizing chemical, metagenomic and enzyme mechanistic insights into the roles gut microbiota play in health-related chemical conversions. The authors convey results from a series of convincing studies that outline the utility of their computational platform, one that will be useful to both specialized microbiome researchers as well as a broad audience of scientists interested in the numerous ways non-host enzymes impact host biology.
